player_prompt.intro:
Yin e Player {player_id} ee SimpleTak.
Tɛ̈ɛ̈n, kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n ee '{player_stone}' ku kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n ee duɛ̈ɛ̈r ee '{opponent_stone}'.

Yɔ̈ɔ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n, ɣɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n (kɛ̈ɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n) ku luɛ̈ɛ̈k kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n.
Kɛ̈ɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n, '[12]' luɛ̈ɛ̈k kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n 12.

Yɔ̈ɔ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n ee duɛ̈ɛ̈r ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n (tɛ̈ɛ̈n-tɛ̈ɛ̈n ku tɛ̈ɛ̈n-tɛ̈ɛ̈n).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Thiɛlɛ mi̱ lotdɛ kɛ ca̱p in jälkɛ jɛ
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Kɔc kee riɛ̈ɛ̈n ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n {cell_num} aɣɔ̈ɔ̈n. Aɣɔ̈ɔ̈n ee kɛ̈ɛ̈n 0 ku {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Thɛli̱ {cell_num} cɛ ku thuŋ te thi̱n. Kiɛ la thɛl mi̱ /thiɛlɛ ŋuänydɛ bi̱ wä rɛy gua̱th ɛmɔ.

action.placement: Riäŋ {current_player_id} thok kekë në ŋɛl {symbol} thïn në cel {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Kɔc kɔɔc {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') acɛ ka wäl kɛɛl kɔɔc!
outcome.draw: Kä cu duël kuɔth thia̱a̱ŋ. Ɛ mi la̱tkɛ kɛ cäätni!
